Records of the interaction queue

Source: R/scene_queue.R
MethodWithArgs.Rd

Upstream's interactive scene reads a queue (scene$queue) while it runs; manimR's interactive window (interactive_scene) does the same.

Usage

MethodWithArgs(method, args = list(), kwargs = list())

SceneInteractContinue(sender)

SceneInteractRerun(sender, ...)

EndSceneEarlyException(message = "end")

RerunSceneException(message = "rerun")

MultiAnimationOverrideException(message = "")

Arguments

method

A function.

args, kwargs

Lists of positional and named arguments.

sender

Who asked: "gui", "keyboard", "play" or "file".

...

Named arguments of the rerun.

message

Condition message.

Value

A record of the class of its name; a condition for the exceptions; RerunSceneHandler is an R6 class generator.

Details

  • MethodWithArgs(method, args, kwargs) is a method to call later with positional args and named kwargs; the animation builder (mob$animate) records its method calls this way.

  • SceneInteractContinue(sender) ends the interaction and the scene continues.

  • SceneInteractRerun(sender, ...) reruns the scene; a from_animation_number among ... sets where the rerun starts.

  • RerunSceneHandler$new(queue) is the file watcher's handler: its on_modified() queues a rerun from "file". The interactive window calls it when the scene's input file changes.

  • EndSceneEarlyException(), RerunSceneException() and MultiAnimationOverrideException() build the conditions of upstream's exceptions (classes manim_end_scene, manim_rerun_scene and manim_multi_override), which render() and MobjectClass$add_animation_override() signal.

Examples

m <- MethodWithArgs(function(x, y = 1) x + y, list(2), list(y = 3))
do.call(m$method, c(m$args, m$kwargs))
#> [1] 5
SceneInteractRerun("keyboard", from_animation_number = 2)$kwargs
#> $from_animation_number
#> [1] 2
#> 
q <- SceneQueue$new()
RerunSceneHandler$new(q)$on_modified()
class(q$get_nowait())
#> [1] "SceneInteractRerun"
tryCatch(stop(RerunSceneException()), manim_rerun_scene = function(e) "rerun")
#> [1] "rerun"
